response.original_title: (Cabin!FAQs) How do I add a cabin to my Freedom of the Seas Cruise?
response.overview: To  add a room, cabin,guest on my Freedom of the Sea Cruise  Line, call Customer Service directly at ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) separate reservation.  To add, upgrade or modify an additional state room or room to 1-866-259-1002 an existing Freedom of the Sea Cruise  reservation, you must book the new room as a separate reservation and call Freedom of the Sea Cruise s Customer Support at 1-866-259-1002
